minecraft:bamboo_sign: A bamboo sign for short notes and labels. Craft six bamboo planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:crimson_sign: A crimson sign for short notes and labels. Craft six crimson planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:warped_sign: A warped sign for short notes and labels. Craft six warped planks and a stick into three signs. Write on both sides, color the text with dye, or wax it with honeycomb to lock it.
minecraft:oak_hanging_sign: A oak sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped oak logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:spruce_hanging_sign: A spruce sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped spruce logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:birch_hanging_sign: A birch sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped birch logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:jungle_hanging_sign: A jungle sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped jungle logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:acacia_hanging_sign: A acacia sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped acacia logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:cherry_hanging_sign: A cherry sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped cherry logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:dark_oak_hanging_sign: A dark oak sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped dark oak logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:mangrove_hanging_sign: A mangrove sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped mangrove logs and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:bamboo_hanging_sign: A bamboo sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped bamboo blocks and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides.
minecraft:crimson_hanging_sign: A crimson sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped crimson stems and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides. It never burns.
minecraft:warped_hanging_sign: A warped sign that hangs from a ceiling by chains or sticks out from a wall. Craft six stripped warped stems and two chains into six signs. Like other signs, you can write on both sides. It never burns.
minecraft:bucket: An iron bucket made from three iron ingots. It scoops up water, lava, powder snow and fish, and milks cows and goats. It is one of the most useful tools you can make.
minecraft:water_bucket: A bucket full of water. Pour it to place a water source; two sources side by side make an endless supply. A quick splash also saves you from fall damage and puts out fires.
minecraft:lava_bucket: A bucket full of lava. As fuel it smelts a hundred items. Pour it carefully: lava burns almost everything it touches.
minecraft:powder_snow_bucket: A bucket of powder snow, collected from snowy slopes. Pour it to place powder snow, which mobs sink into and freeze. Leather boots let you walk on top of it.
minecraft:snowball: A ball of snow made by digging snow with a shovel. Throw it to knock back mobs; it hurts blazes. Four craft into a snow block.
minecraft:leather: Hide dropped by cows, horses, llamas, mooshrooms and hoglins. It makes leather armor, books, item frames and bundles. Rabbit hide also crafts into it.
minecraft:milk_bucket: A bucket of milk from a cow, goat or mooshroom. Drinking it removes all status effects, good and bad. It is also needed for cake.
minecraft:pufferfish_bucket: A bucket holding a live pufferfish. Pour it out to release the fish somewhere else. Watch out: pufferfish puff up and poison anything nearby.
minecraft:salmon_bucket: A bucket holding a live salmon. Pour it out to release the fish into a new home. Use an empty water bucket on a salmon to catch one.
minecraft:cod_bucket: A bucket holding a live cod. Pour it out to release the fish into a new home. Use a water bucket on a cod to catch one.
minecraft:tropical_fish_bucket: A bucket holding a live tropical fish, keeping its colors and pattern. Pour it out to release it into an aquarium. Use a water bucket on one to catch it.
minecraft:axolotl_bucket: A bucket holding a live axolotl. Pour it out to release it; axolotls help you fight underwater mobs. Use a water bucket on one in a lush cave to catch it.
minecraft:tadpole_bucket: A bucket holding a live tadpole. Pour it out to release it; it grows into a frog whose color depends on the climate. Use a water bucket on one to catch it.
minecraft:brick: A small clay brick made by smelting a clay ball. Four craft into a brick block. Three make a flower pot.
minecraft:clay_ball: A lump of clay from breaking a clay block. Smelt it into a brick. Four craft back into a clay block.
minecraft:dried_kelp_block: Nine dried kelp packed into a block. As fuel it smelts twenty items. It is also a compostable decorative block.
minecraft:paper: Sheets made from three sugar cane. It is used for books, maps and firework rockets. Librarians and cartographers trade for it.
minecraft:book: A book made from three paper and a piece of leather. It makes bookshelves, enchanting tables and the book and quill. Enchant it to store an enchantment for later.
minecraft:slime_ball: A ball of slime dropped by slimes, also sneezed by panda cubs. It makes sticky pistons, leads, slime blocks and magma cream. Nine craft into a slime block.
minecraft:egg: An egg laid by chickens. Throw it for a small chance to hatch a chick. It is used to bake cake and pumpkin pie.
minecraft:compass: A compass that points to the world spawn. Use it on a lodestone to point there instead. Craft it from four iron ingots around redstone.
minecraft:recovery_compass: A compass that points to where you last died. Craft it from eight echo shards around a compass. It spins aimlessly if you haven't died in this dimension.
minecraft:bundle: A small pouch that holds a stack's worth of mixed items in one slot. Craft it from rabbit hide and string. In this version it is an experimental item.
minecraft:fishing_rod: A rod made from three sticks and two string. Cast it into water to catch fish and sometimes treasure. You can also hook mobs and pull them toward you.
minecraft:clock: A clock made from four gold ingots around redstone. It shows the position of the sun and moon. It doesn't work in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:spyglass: A small telescope made from two copper ingots and an amethyst shard. Hold right-click to zoom in on faraway things. It is great for scouting.
minecraft:glowstone_dust: Dust from breaking glowstone. It makes potions stronger, lights up spectral arrows and crafts back into glowstone. Four dust form one glowstone block.
minecraft:cod: A raw fish caught by fishing or from cod in oceans. Eat it for a little food, or cook it for more. Cats and ocelots love it.
minecraft:salmon: A raw fish caught by fishing or from salmon in rivers and cold oceans. Eat it raw or cook it for more food. Cats and ocelots love it.
minecraft:tropical_fish: A colourful fish caught in warm oceans. It gives very little food. Axolotls are fed with buckets of tropical fish.
minecraft:pufferfish: A spiky fish that poisons you if eaten, causing nausea and hunger. It is brewed into potions of water breathing. Live pufferfish puff up and sting anything that swims too close.
minecraft:cooked_cod: A cooked cod fillet. Cook raw cod in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is a decent, easy food.
minecraft:cooked_salmon: A cooked salmon fillet, more filling than cooked cod. Cook raw salmon in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is one of the better fish foods.
minecraft:ink_sac: A sac of black ink dropped by squids. It works as black dye and makes the book and quill. Use it on a sign to make glowing text dark again.
minecraft:glow_ink_sac: A glowing ink sac dropped by glow squids. Use it on a sign to make the text glow. It crafts glow item frames.
minecraft:cocoa_beans: Beans that grow in pods on jungle logs. They make brown dye and cookies. Plant them on jungle logs to grow more.
minecraft:white_dye: A white dye made from bone meal or lilies of the valley. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:orange_dye: A orange dye made from orange tulips, torchflowers, or red and yellow dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:magenta_dye: A magenta dye made from alliums, lilacs, or mixing purple and pink dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:light_blue_dye: A light blue dye made from blue orchids, or blue and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:yellow_dye: A yellow dye made from dandelions or sunflowers. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:lime_dye: A lime dye made from smelting sea pickles, or green and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:pink_dye: A pink dye made from pink tulips, peonies, pink petals, or red and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:gray_dye: A gray dye made from mixing black and white dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:light_gray_dye: A light gray dye made from azure bluets, oxeye daisies, white tulips, or mixing dyes. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:cyan_dye: A cyan dye made from pitcher plants, or blue and green dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:purple_dye: A purple dye made from mixing blue and red dye. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:blue_dye: A blue dye made from lapis lazuli or cornflowers. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:brown_dye: A brown dye made from cocoa beans. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:green_dye: A green dye made from smelting cactus. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:red_dye: A red dye made from poppies, red tulips, rose bushes or beetroots. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:black_dye: A black dye made from ink sacs or wither roses. Use it to color wool, glass, terracotta, concrete, candles, banners and leather armor. Use it on a sheep to dye its wool.
minecraft:bone_meal: A fertilizer made from bones or a composter. It makes crops, saplings and flowers grow instantly. It also works as white dye.
minecraft:bone: A bone dropped by skeletons. It crafts into three bone meal. Feed it to a wolf to tame it.
minecraft:sugar: Sweet crystals made from sugar cane. It goes into cake, pumpkin pie and fermented spider eyes. It brews into potions of swiftness.
minecraft:cake: A cake made from milk, sugar, an egg and wheat. Place it and eat it one slice at a time; it has seven slices. Put a candle on top for a birthday cake.
minecraft:white_bed: A white bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three white wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:orange_bed: A orange bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three orange wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:magenta_bed: A magenta bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three magenta wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:light_blue_bed: A light blue bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three light blue wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:yellow_bed: A yellow bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three yellow wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:lime_bed: A lime bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three lime wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:pink_bed: A pink bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three pink wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:gray_bed: A gray bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three gray wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:light_gray_bed: A light gray bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three light gray wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:cyan_bed: A cyan bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three cyan wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:purple_bed: A purple bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three purple wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:blue_bed: A blue bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three blue wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:brown_bed: A brown bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three brown wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:green_bed: A green bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three green wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:red_bed: A red bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three red wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:black_bed: A black bed for sleeping through the night and setting your respawn point. Craft it from three black wool and three planks. It explodes if you try to sleep in the Nether or the End.
minecraft:cookie: A small sweet made from two wheat and cocoa beans, eight at a time. It restores a little hunger. Never feed one to a parrot.
minecraft:crafter: A block that crafts automatically when powered by redstone. Lay out the recipe in its 3x3 grid and lock the slots you don't need. Craft it from iron, redstone, a crafting table and a dropper.
minecraft:filled_map: A map showing the area you have explored. Hold it to fill it in as you walk. Use a cartography table to zoom, copy or lock it.
minecraft:shears: A tool made from two iron ingots. Shear sheep for wool and collect leaves, vines, cobwebs and grass. It also carves faces into pumpkins.
minecraft:melon_slice: A juicy slice of melon. It restores a little hunger. Nine craft into a whole melon, and one gives melon seeds.
minecraft:dried_kelp: Kelp dried in a furnace or smoker. It is a quick snack you can eat very fast. Nine pack into a dried kelp block.
minecraft:pumpkin_seeds: Seeds from a pumpkin. Plant them on farmland with an empty space next to it, where the pumpkin grows. One pumpkin crafts into four seeds.
minecraft:melon_seeds: Seeds from a melon slice. Plant them on farmland with an empty space next to it, where the melon grows. Villages and jungles sometimes have them in chests.
minecraft:beef: Raw beef dropped by cows and mooshrooms. It is edible raw but gives more food cooked. Cook it into steak.
minecraft:cooked_beef: A cooked steak, one of the most filling foods in the game. Cook raw beef in a furnace, smoker or campfire. Cows killed by fire drop it already cooked.
minecraft:chicken: Raw chicken dropped by chickens. Eating it raw may give you hunger. Cook it to make it safe.
minecraft:cooked_chicken: A cooked chicken, safe and filling. Cook raw chicken in a furnace, smoker or campfire. It is a good everyday food.
minecraft:rotten_flesh: Decaying meat dropped by zombies. Eating it fills you a little but may give you hunger. Wolves can eat it safely, and clerics buy it.
minecraft:ender_pearl: A pearl dropped by endermen. Throw it to teleport where it lands, taking some damage. Combine it with blaze powder to make an eye of ender.
minecraft:blaze_rod: A glowing rod dropped by blazes in nether fortresses. It crafts the brewing stand and breaks down into blaze powder. It is also strong fuel.
minecraft:ghast_tear: A tear dropped by ghasts. It brews potions of regeneration. It is also needed to craft end crystals.
minecraft:gold_nugget: A small piece of gold from nether gold ore, smelted gold gear or zombified piglins. Nine craft into a gold ingot. It makes golden carrots and glistering melon slices.
minecraft:nether_wart: A red fungus that grows on soul sand, found in nether fortresses. It is the base of almost every potion, brewing water into awkward potion. Plant it on soul sand to grow more.
minecraft:potion: A drinkable bottle with an effect, brewed at a brewing stand. Start from a water bottle and nether wart, then add ingredients for different effects. Gunpowder makes it a splash potion.
minecraft:glass_bottle: A bottle made from three glass. Fill it with water, collect honey from a full beehive, or catch dragon's breath. It is the starting point for every potion.
minecraft:spider_eye: An eye dropped by spiders and witches. Eating it poisons you. It brews potions of poison and makes fermented spider eyes.
minecraft:fermented_spider_eye: A spider eye fermented with sugar and a brown mushroom. In brewing it corrupts potions, turning them into their opposite. It makes potions of weakness, slowness and invisibility.
minecraft:blaze_powder: Fiery powder made from a blaze rod. It fuels the brewing stand and brews potions of strength. It also makes eyes of ender and fire charges.
minecraft:magma_cream: A fiery slime dropped by magma cubes, or crafted from a slimeball and blaze powder. It brews potions of fire resistance. Four craft into a magma block.
minecraft:brewing_stand: A stand for brewing potions, made from a blaze rod and three cobblestone. Put up to three bottles below and an ingredient on top. It runs on blaze powder.
minecraft:cauldron: An iron pot made from seven iron ingots. It holds water, lava or powder snow, and fills slowly in rain or snow. Use the water to wash dye off leather, banners and shulker boxes.
